title: On Refusing the offer without argument
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：refuse　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 refuse 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the keeper ① refused the offer without argument without a word of thanks, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② refuses the offer without argument at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ refuse the offer without argument at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ refused the offer without argument before — a line in the register for March 1980 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Refusing the offer without argument without a word of thanks, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ refuse to sign until the conditions changed at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Refuse to sign until the conditions changed at once and never mention it again.

By 1993 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ refuses to sign until the conditions changed without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ refused the offer without argument again when nobody else would.

⑩ To refuse the offer without argument, my mother said in 1998, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody refuses the offer without argument at once again and somebody must refuse the offer without argument without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 拒绝（一般过去式 refused the offer without argument：1986 年饲养员头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 拒绝（一般现在 refuses the offer without argument：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 拒绝（不定式 to refuse the offer without argument：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 拒绝（过去完成时 had refused the offer without argument：1980 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 拒绝（动名词 refusing the offer without argument 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 不肯（refuse to sign until the conditions changed：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去不肯条件不改就不肯签字）
G. v. 不肯（refuse to sign until the conditions changed：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 拒绝（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 refuses to sign until the conditions changed，而母亲又一次 refused the offer without argument）

answers.why: refuse 意为“拒绝”，1986 年饲养员不图一句谢拒绝二话不说拒了那份提议，那是兽舍里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 refused。
refuse 意为“拒绝”，自那以后饲养员二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 refuses。
refuse 意为“拒绝”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯拒绝二话不说拒了那份提议”，此处为不定式 to refuse the offer without argument。
refuse 意为“拒绝”，饲养台账里 三月 那行字说明早在 1993 年之前就有人拒绝过，故用过去完成时 had refused。
refuse 意为“拒绝”，饲养员说“拒绝二话不说拒了那份提议这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 refusing the offer without argument 作主语。
refuse 意为“不肯”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去不肯条件不改就不肯签字”，should ever 之后用原形 refuse to sign until the conditions changed。
refuse 意为“不肯”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻不肯条件不改就不肯签字（refuse to sign until the conditions changed at once），以后再也不要提起。
refuse 意为“拒绝”，新来的孩子每个季度都照例不肯条件不改就不肯签字，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 refuses。
refuse 意为“拒绝”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢拒绝二话不说拒了那份提议，用一般过去式 refused 叙述。
refuse 意为“拒绝”，结尾那句是母亲 1998 年的话：要拒绝二话不说拒了那份提议，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和兽舍记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 refuse 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the keeper refused the offer without argument without a word of thanks, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper refuses the offer without argument at once whenever the zoo asks.
Refusing the offer without argument without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever refuse to sign until the conditions changed at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo refuses to sign until the conditions changed without a word of thanks every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother refused the offer without argument again, and the zoo remembered that half.
